qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unreplicable Biscoff taste profile and patented caramelisation baking process backed by cult global brand equity and expanding Natural Foods pillar. qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle financials (2022-2025): Revenue expanded from €877.5M (FY22) to €1,063.0M (FY23), €1,231.9M (FY24), and €1,355.1M (FY25), driven by double-digit organic volume expansion across North America, Europe, and Asia. Operating profit (EBIT) grew from €137.1M to €228.5M with operating margins expanding from 15.6% to 16.9%. 4Y median GAAP ROIC is 18.52% (15.6%, 18.1%, 19.0%, 19.1%) and Tangible Operating ROIC is 34.7% (32.3%-36.7%). Multi-year Owner FCF conversion is 92.3% (FY25 FCF €163.5M vs NI €172.3M). Peak-to-peak compounding is pristine: Owner EPS compounded at 18.6% CAGR from €127.13 (2022) to €159.12 (2023), €187.65 (2024), and €211.88 (2025). Balance sheet is pristine: FY25 Total Debt €236.0M, Cash €121.9M, Net Debt €114.1M (0.66x NI), EBIT/Interest 69.3x (€228.5M / €3.3M).
